svg.aria-label: What a run of the paper skill leaves behind. paper-runs/<mode>-<date>/, beside the manuscript's folder: config.md: every mode and call; final.md: every mode and call; checks.md: full, revision, citation-check, draft-review, lit-review, format-convert; review.md: full, outline-only, lit-review; refs.bib: full, outline-only, lit-review; outline.md: full, outline-only, plan; arguments.md: full; intended-claims.md: full; existing-main.tex: full, the copy of a main.tex that stood there; draft-report.md: full, with the trace table; figures/ and figures.md: full, figures; citation-report.md: full, revision, citation-check; citation-report-<nn>.md: full, revision, one per incremental check; review-<r>.md: full, one per round; review-2.md: revision; review-1.md: draft-review; items.md: revision; revision-log.md: revision; response-letter-check.md: revision, response-letter; rebuttal-audit.md: rebuttal-audit; disclosure.md: disclosure; format-report.md: full, format-convert; dialogue.md, chapter-summaries.md, insights.md, chapter-plan.md: plan; The parsed comments, the roadmap, the tracking template, the letter skeleton: revision-coach | patches/, in the run folder: the four files of each patch, named by its number: <nn>-<file name>.block-manifest.json: the manifest; <nn>-<file name>.patch.json: the patch an agent writes; <nn>-<file name>.patched: the patched file; <nn>-<file name>.patched.apply-report.json: the apply report | The manuscript's folder: main.tex: full; refs.bib: full, when none stands there; figures/: full, figures; response-letter.md: revision, response-letter; cover-letter.tex: format-convert, for a journal venue with none there; <main>.pdf: full, revision, format-convert; <main>.docx and <main>.md: full, format-convert; <name>.tex, refs.bib and figures/: format-convert, from a .md or a .docx.
